fdroid:com.leastauthority.destiny.name: Destiny
fdroid:com.leastauthority.destiny.summary: Send files with end-to-end encryption without revealing your identity
fdroid:com.leastauthority.destiny.description:
Destiny is an end-to-end encrypted file transfer app. It allows people to securely send files without needing to reveal their identity to each other, or the service provider. No sign-up is needed.
The user selects a file on their device and shares the generated code with the intended recipient for safe delivery.
Destiny is based on the Magic Wormhole protocol.
Key security features:
- End-to-end encryption: Files are end-to-end encrypted and only the sender and recipient can read them.
- Identity-less: No need to disclose identity information (such as name, email address, or phone number) to be able to transfer files.
- Peer-to-peer file transfer: Destiny attempts to make a direct network connection to the other party. When this isn’t possible (for example, if neither party has a public IP address), then our relay server is used. However, that server sees only encrypted packets.
- Full-strength keys: Although our codes are short and human-memorable, they are part of an online “Password Authenticated Key Exchange” (PAKE) which only allows a single guess – and yields a 256-bit full-strength symmetric key.

fdroid:page.ooooo.geoshare.summary: Open map links in other map apps and copy coordinates
fdroid:page.ooooo.geoshare.description:
Share a map link with GeoShare and the app will open it in another installed map app.
 Supported map links 
- Google Maps
- Apple Maps
- 2GIS
- Amap (AutoNavi)
- Baidu Map (beta)
- Cartes IGN
- CoMaps
- HERE WeGo
- Kagi Maps
- Magic Earth
- MapQuest
- Maps.me
- Mapy.com
- OpenStreetMap
- Organic Maps
- OsmAnd
- Plus Codes (global only)
- Urbi
- Waze
- Yahoo! Maps
- Yandex Maps
- coordinates
GeoShare is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the services mentioned.
 Example use cases 
When someone sends you a Google Maps link, but you prefer using OpenStreetMap, you can quickly open the same location in OsmAnd or Organic Maps.
When you like Google Maps for finding places, but you prefer a different app for navigation, you can easily switch from Google Maps to your favorite navigation app .
 Other features 
- Shows the geographic coordinates of a map link and allows copying them to clipboard in various formats, for example as a geo: link.
- Shows all points of a place list link.
- Allows performing an action automatically when a map link is processed. (Pro feature)
- Allows launching navigation in all apps that support it, including TomTom.
- Allows opening a location in web maps , pre-installed ones or your own. (Pro feature)
- Allows saving a location as a GPX file .
- Allows sending a location via a messaging app .
- Allows saving a location to a contact .
- Retries on patchy internet connection .
- Allows pasting map links directly into the app, instead of sharing them with it.
- Interface adapts to tablets .
 How it works and privacy considerations 
GeoShare converts map links (e.g. https://maps.app.goo.gl/...) into geo: links that can be opened by other map apps. To create a geo: link, geographic coordinates are required. GeoShare reads them from the map URL.
However, not all map URLs include coordinates. In such cases, GeoShare will prompt you for permission to connect to the map service (Google Maps, Apple Maps, etc.) and read the coordinates from HTTP headers, HTML document, or an API. For more detailed information, check the app’s FAQ screen.

apple-macos:6787310678.description:
Tap the World is an educational game that teaches world geography through play. It works like a map quiz: the game names a country, you find it on an interactive globe, and every answer teaches you something new. Then practice flags and capitals with Geo Flashcards. There is no time limit, so you can learn at your own pace.
HOW TO PLAY
• Choose the whole world or a single region, and the game asks you to find a country. Tap it on the globe.
• Switch to Flags to turn the map quiz into a flag quiz: find each country by its flag and learn flags as you play.
• Every correct answer shows the country's name and its capital.
• A wrong tap shows which country you actually picked, so you learn from your mistakes too.
• Each game gives you 3 lives, so you can make a couple of mistakes and keep going.
• Tap any country you have already found to see its name and capital again.
• Even the smallest countries are easy to tap.
GAME MODES
• World: more than 220 countries and territories in one game.
• Regions: Europe, Africa, South America, North & Central America, Central & West Asia, South, East & Southeast Asia, and Australia & Oceania.
• US States: all 50 states plus Washington, D.C.
LEARN FLAGS AND CAPITALS
• Practice in four directions: country to capital, capital to country, flag to country, and country to flag.
• See the question, recall the answer, then flip the card to check yourself.
• Cards you are still learning come back for another look, and the ones you know are set aside.
• Your progress is saved, so you can continue where you left off.
A LEARNING GAME FOR GEOGRAPHY STUDENTS
Tap the World turns geography lessons into a game. Play it to prepare for a geography test, review what you covered in class, or finally remember where every country is and what its capital is called. Start with one region, then play through all the countries of the world as you learn.
LEADERBOARD
Post your best World score on the Game Center leaderboard.
EXPLORER MODE
Unlock Explorer Mode to remove ads and play in Training mode: unlimited attempts and hints that turn the globe to the country you are looking for. Training is pure practice, so the leaderboard stays fair for everyone.
Learn geography in 10 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese and Chinese.

firefox-addons:3023367.summary: Automatically blurs messages, media, names, and more, on WhatsApp Web until you hover. Actively maintained community fork
firefox-addons:3023367.description:
Privacy for WhatsApp Web (Auto Blur WA) protects your screen from shoulder-surfing and prying eyes at work, cafe or coffee shops, or any public places. This extension automatically blurs your WhatsApp, instantly revealing items only when you hover your mouse cursor over them.
 Note: This project is an actively maintained community fork of the original open-source extension, updated to fix recent layout bugs and keep our privacy tools working smoothly. 
It adapts to your needs by letting you decide which elements you want to blur. 
Your options:
- All messages in chat: Blurs all messages in the current chat.
- Last messages preview: Blurs all message previews on the left.
- Media preview: Blurs all images, videos, stickers, etc. in separation from the text.
- Media gallery: Blurs all small icons of images, videos, etc. while viewing an image, video, etc.
- Text input: Makes the color in your input field lighter to make it hard to read.
- Profile pictures: Blurs all profile pictures.
- Group/Users names: Blurs all group and usernames.
- No transition delay: Allows you to turn off the delay before revealing an item on hover.
- Unblur all on app hover: Unblurs all elements when you hover over the WhatsApp Web app.
- Blur WhatsApp on Idle: Blurs WhatsApp when there is no mouse/keyboard activity after a certain time.
- Advanced Settings: Customize the blur amount (in pixels) for various elements independently and set the idle timeout duration.
- Theme Toggle: Switch between Light, Dark, or System Preference theme for the extension.
 Quick Toggle Shortcut 
Quickly toggle all blur effects on or off globally using the button in the extension menu or via a keyboard shortcut (Default: Alt+X). To customize this hotkey, navigate to: "about:addons" -> Settings icon on the top right -> Manage Extension Shortcuts
 No Tracking 
This extension does not collect any information about you, your settings, or your messages. Everything stays locally in your browser.
 MIT Licensed 
Proudly running as an open-source continuation fork under the MIT license.
 Disclaimer: WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. This extension is an independent, community-driven open-source project and has no official relationship to WhatsApp or WhatsApp Inc.

firefox-addons:2874604.name: Accessible Shortcuts
firefox-addons:2874604.summary: Enables the creation of accessible keyboard shortcuts for focusing on elements within a web page.
firefox-addons:2874604.description: With this extension you will be able to easily create shortcuts to focus elements on a web page. Just use the Tab key to focus on an element on the page and then use the add shortcut shortcut. A sound will be played and you must press the key combination that will be the shortcut to the element in focus. By default, the shortcut to add a new shortcut is “Alt + Control + Shift + A”. After executing this shortcut, make the desired combination for the focused element, such as “Alt + j”. A confirmation box will be displayed, press the “Ok” button to confirm or activate the “Cancel” button so that the shortcut is not created. Settings page: The default shortcut to access the settings page is “Alt + Control + Shift + C”. When you run it, the extension page will open and you can check the created shortcuts as well as the default shortcuts. Managing shortcuts: Shortcuts created: On the settings page, find the “Created Shortcuts” heading. If you have created any shortcuts, there will be a table containing all those that have been added. In the “Action” column, you can activate the “Delete” button to delete the corresponding shortcut. Default shortcuts: In the same way, you will be able to find the title “Default shortcuts” and the corresponding table with the shortcuts to add a new shortcut and the shortcut to open the settings page. You can activate the “Edit” button in the “Action” column to configure a new key combination for the corresponding shortcut. For example, when you activate the “Edit” button for the add new shortcut shortcut “Alt + Control + Shift + A”, a sound will be played and you must press the new key combination to become that shortcut. So, if you press the “Alt + a” keys, this will be the new shortcut to create shortcuts. A confirmation box will be displayed before the new key combination is registered. Other information: Subscribe to the channel Continue Desenvolvendo on Youtube and access the website Juliano Lopes - Atalhos Acessíveis (Accessible Shortcuts) to stay informed about any updates.

firefox-addons:3019023.name: UnitNormalize - Shopping Tool
firefox-addons:3019023.summary: Finally, something that fights shrinkflation. Instantly calculates and displays real price-per-unit badges on Amazon search results, so you always know the real deal.
firefox-addons:3019023.description:
Supermarkets and brands have quietly been shrinking product sizes while keeping prices the same — or raising them. UnitNormalize fights back.
The moment you search on Amazon, UnitNormalize scans every product on the page, extracts the weight, volume, or count from the product title, does the math instantly, and injects a price-per-unit badge directly under the price. No clicking. No copying numbers into a calculator. Just the truth, right there on the page.
How it works
UnitNormalize reads the product title locally in your browser — things like "32 oz", "6-pack (12 fl oz each)", "500g", or "96 count" — calculates the real unit price, and displays it in a small green badge beneath the listed price. The product with the lowest price-per-unit on the page gets a special "Best" highlight so the winner is always obvious at a glance.
Features
• Instant price-per-unit badges on Amazon search results
• Handles weight (oz, g, kg, lb), volume (fl oz, ml, L, gal), and count (tablets, pods, wipes, rolls, etc.)
• Understands multi-packs — "12 × 500ml", "4-pack 16 oz each", "6-count" all parsed correctly
• Best Value highlight — the lowest unit price on the page is automatically flagged
• Switch between Imperial (per oz / per fl oz) and Metric (per 100g / per 100ml) in one click
• Works on infinite scroll and paginated results via live page monitoring
• Fully isolated badges — never broken by Amazon's own CSS
Privacy
UnitNormalize does all calculations instantly inside your browser. It reads nothing except the product titles and prices already visible on the page. No data is collected, stored remotely, transmitted, or shared. Ever. This is declared explicitly in the extension manifest.
Permissions
UnitNormalize only requests access to Amazon search result pages and local browser storage for your unit preference (imperial or metric). No other permissions are needed or requested.

firefox-addons:419210.name: All Tabs Helper
firefox-addons:419210.summary: Provides list-style menu to do closing, loading, unloading, moving of single/multiple tabs. Search tab titles/urls, search content in all loaded tabs, visited tabs history, find duplicate tabs. (Window-centric except moves tabs across windows)
firefox-addons:419210.description:
(Note: ATH versions >= 1.1.1 will not work on Firefox versions < 58.)
 Summary 
This addon provides a list-style UI for tab management. Designed mainly for high-volume tab users.
The ATH UI can be accessed 3 ways: From the toolbar button popup, in the sidebar, or in the management window (aka "full view" window). Each UI provides 4 different views, also referred to as "menus":
 all - All tabs are displayed in tabs bar order, or can be filtered by title and url by typing in the search box.
 recent - Lists tabs in order from most recently accessed first.
 dups - Duplicate tabs are displayed. (See caveat*)
 search - Tabs can be searched by tabs content of loaded tabs.
The screenshots and captioned instructions give a good introduction to using ATH.
Note that ATH is window-centric, ie, menu only applies to the window it is in. The only cross-window support is the ability to move multiple tabs across windows. Demonstration for this is also shown in the screenshots.
(EDIT: ATH now has multi-window functionality, however it is experimental and currrently considered "unsupported". Must be enabled in Options.)
* caveats :
Dup tabs - Note that dup tabs list is generated by searching for tabs with identical URLs. It is possible for two tabs to have the same URL but different content, eg the case where the page is generated based on form or cookie data. Use with awareness when removing tabs.
 Reasons for permissions :
 Access your data for all websites - Listing and searching tabs - used for the highlighting within the page that is used in the "Search all tabs" feature when the user clicks on a search result in the ATH UI.
 Read and modify browser settings - ATH option "Open new tab next to current" changes FF pref
 Read the text of all open tabs - Searching tabs content ("search" menu)
 Access recently closed tabs - Used to store data that is window oriented, such as window title names
 Access browser tabs - Listing and searching tabs
(Note: To be clear, ATH does not modify any part of any page for spoofing, nor scavenge any user input, in order learn any user information, including but not limited to passwords etc.)
Note for Legacy Firefox users: I am making a few concessions to allow ATH to run on Firefox 56 (the last legacy version.) I'd like to make it clear that I am officially not supporting Firefox 56. Some features will not work, or be inapplicable, due to the lack of APIs in Firefox 56. I have only made attempts to allow what will work to work, without breakage, however I am not taking the time to make a customized UI. Thus you may find options, features or context menu items listed that won't apply to you. You may also find bugs which won't be fixed.
In this same paradigm, I cannot guarantee that all future updates of ATH will continue to work on Firefox 56 (or variants.) To be safe you may want to turn off automatic updates and only do updates where you can monitor which is the last version that will work for you.

apple-macos:6759073615.description:
Pharo on iOS brings the complete Pharo 13 Smalltalk programming environment to your Apple devices. Browse classes,
 write code, inspect objects, and debug — all running natively with Metal-accelerated graphics.
 FULL PHARO DESKTOP
 Run unmodified official Pharo 13 images. The System Browser, Playground, Inspector, Debugger, and every tool you
 know from desktop Pharo works here. No special images required.
 BUILT FOR TOUCH
 Intuitive gesture mapping makes Pharo comfortable on a touchscreen. Tap for left-click, long-press for right-click,
 two-finger tap for middle-click. Pinch to zoom. Full hardware keyboard support with modifier keys on iPad.
 NATIVE PERFORMANCE
 A clean-room interpreter written in C++ with Metal GPU rendering. Smooth 30fps display, efficient memory
 management, and full foreign function interface support.
 IMAGE LIBRARY
 Download official Pharo 13 images directly from the app. Import your own .image files from the Files app. Keep
 multiple images organized and switch between projects easily.
 WORKS EVERYWHERE
 Universal app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac (via Mac Catalyst). Your Pharo environment goes wherever you do.
 PRIVACY FIRST
 No accounts, no telemetry, no data collection. Your code stays on your device. Period.
 OPEN SOURCE
 The VM is MIT-licensed and open source. Contributions welcome.

apple-macos:1665075144.name: Archi - Kids Read-Along Story
apple-macos:1665075144.description:
Welcome to the magnificent Island of Phi Phi, where Archi and the island puppers live and play. Archi has always struggled to fit in because he was born different—with a cute arched tail and an inability to speak a word. But when a drought strikes and Archi is unknowingly left alone on the island, he stumbles upon a miracle. One by one, his deepest prayers are answered. For his final prayer, Archi wishes for the one thing he has always longed for. Will Archi get his heart’s desire and finally find his place on the island?
— A HEARTWARMING JOURNEY OF HOPE AND ANSWERED PRAYERS
When the world feels quiet and lonely, where do we turn? Archi is a beautifully crafted interactive experience that follows a non-verbal hero who discovers the power of reaching out. It is a comforting tool for parents and educators to help children navigate hardships, find their voice through reflection, and see the miracles that happen when we keep a hopeful heart.
— WHY FAMILIES LOVE ARCHI:
* Read and Learn Together: Children can listen to the story with Read-to-Me narration, hear it read aloud, and follow along with the text. These features encourage reading practice, help children repeat new words, build confidence, and enjoy a shared reading experience.
* Active Participation: Kids don't just watch—they Tap, Pull, Pop, and Drag objects, making them active participants in Archi’s journey toward his heart's desire.
* A Pure Experience: 100% Kid-Safe. No ads, no in-app purchases, and no external links. It’s a secure, distraction-free environment for independent exploration.
* Literacy & Learning: Professional narration and Read-to-Me modes help preschool children and early readers build vocabulary, practice reading, and gain confidence as they learn to read.
* A gentle Christian storybook that helps beginner readers build vocabulary, explore Christian faith, and enjoy interactive family reading.
— KEY FEATURES
* Available Anywhere, Anytime: 100% offline functionality. Once downloaded, the story, animations, and audio—including read-aloud and read-along functions—work perfectly without an internet connection, making Archi ideal for travel.
* Great for Teachers and Students: Perfect for classroom reading, small-group activities, and discussions about faith, kindness, empathy, and personal growth.
* Great for Preschool & Early Readers: A gentle interactive book for preschool children and early readers who are beginning to develop reading skills.
* Read-Along Storybook: Children can listen to professional narration while following along with the words, making Archi an engaging read-along book for independent or family reading.
* A Children’s Book for Family Reading: Enjoy Archi together as a children’s book that encourages parents to read with kids and share meaningful moments.
* Bedtime Stories: The gentle pace, narration, music, and interactive elements make Archi a comforting choice for heartwarming tales and a peaceful bedtime routine.
* Bible Stories & Christian Faith: Archi incorporates Bible-inspired themes of prayer, hope, perseverance, and answered prayers, offering families an opportunity to explore Christian faith.
* Bible Verse: And I tell you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks it will be opened. (Luke 11: 9-10, ESV)
— A STORY OF RESILIENCE
Archi’s journey reminds us that even when we feel alone, help is never far away. By focusing on the universal values of persistence and faith, Archi bridges the gap between feeling lost and finding a home. It is a celebration of the quiet strength found in every child’s heart.

apple-macos:6796871892.name: myHealthRoutine
apple-macos:6796871892.description:
Keep a daily food diary alongside your blood pressure readings, medications and vitamins.
Today guides sleep review, medications and vitamins, blood pressure and meals. The next unfinished step appears first; record in any order. Filter Timeline by one or more activity types.
Record blood pressure, pulse, notes and time, as one reading or a session of three with a labelled average. Between session readings you'll see a short health tip from public health sources.
Insights shows neutral 7-day, 30-day, 90-day and all-time averages and daily charts. Optional reference indicators compare readings and averages with common adult home-average bands. Each indicator pairs colour with a symbol and neutral text label, so colour is never the only way the information is communicated.
Reviewed adult reference bands are not changed based only on age group or gender, so myHealthRoutine does not collect either detail for this feature. The indicators are informational, do not set a personal treatment target, and are not intended for anyone under 18, during pregnancy, or in the six weeks after giving birth.
Find over 5,000 USDA foods offline or search branded packs online. Log portions by meal and review daily nutrition totals. Log caffeine, alcohol (standard drinks) and sugar, and see neutral daily totals in Insights. Amounts are self-reported estimates; myHealthRoutine does not set targets or give advice about them.
Keep medications, symptoms, stress moments, appointments, activity, meals, sleep and other events in a searchable Health Timeline. You can also keep up to 12 active reminders.
Print a standard report of averages, readings, neutral reference labels, source context and medical caveats to discuss with your healthcare provider, or export your readings and intake as CSV.
Compatible myDailyTasks versions support blood-pressure handoffs, planned-meal reminders and same-device routine completion. Routine updates appear when myDailyTasks next runs. Only workflow details are shared, never health measurements.
On iPhone and iPad, Apple Health is optional. myHealthRoutine can save blood pressure, pulse, caffeine, alcohol and sugar you enter, and can read workouts, steps, sleep, State of Mind, heart-rate information, high-heart-rate notifications and intake from other apps to show in Today, the Timeline and Insights. State of Mind and sleep are shown as recorded, without diagnosis or a clinical score, and myHealthRoutine never creates a medical alert. Displayed Apple Health context stays in Health; a confirmed sleep review saves your selected duration.
Your health journal stays on your device and is excluded from backups. An optional iCloud bridge exchanges limited companion completion receipts, not your health journal.
myHealthRoutine is ad-supported and may show one clearly labelled, contextual sponsor message on the Readings home and while you wait between session readings. Sponsor selection never uses health information, and myHealthRoutine does not provide sponsors with health data, user identifiers, impression data or click analytics. There is no subscription or in-app purchase.
Aggregate product analytics is optional and off by default. If you turn it on in the introduction or Settings, myHealthRoutine sends first-party grouped counts of app opens, feature views and completed actions, with the app version and platform. It does not send health values, notes, food or intake records, Apple Health data, individual action timestamps, account or device identifiers, or advertising identifiers, and it is not shared with sponsors or used for tracking.
Apple Watch is a reminder companion. myHealthRoutine is a personal record-keeping tool and does not diagnose conditions, recommend treatment, or provide emergency alerts.
Privacy Policy: https://myhealthroutine.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

firefox-addons:3104266.name: Twinread: Dual Subtitles & Translator
firefox-addons:3104266.summary: Two languages at once: dual subtitles on YouTube and other videos, and on-device translation under each paragraph of a page.
firefox-addons:3104266.description:
Watch YouTube with subtitles in two languages, and read any web page with its translation under each paragraph. Twinread is a dual subtitles extension and bilingual page translator for language learners: hear the original, read both lines, pause after each one, and keep the words you want to learn.
Translation runs on your computer. No account.
• Video on YouTube and other sites: each line in two languages, the whole video, a transcript beside the player, a pause after each line, a repeat, a click on any word for its translation
• Bilingual page translator: the translation under each paragraph, or the translation alone
• Saved words, each with the sentence it came from, reviewed as flashcards on a spaced schedule, and sent to Anki (Pro)
• PDFs, your own EPUB, text and HTML files, and your own subtitle files, read the same way
• Reading aids on subtitles: furigana and romaji for Japanese, pinyin for Chinese
• A sentence explained, its meaning and grammar, by your own key
• Anki cards with the picture and the sound of the line (Pro)
• The site's own second caption track beside the translation, slow replay of a line and Hear, which reads a word aloud with a voice on your computer
Translation: Bergamot, on your computer.
Free translates every page and video and covers saved words, a reader for your own files and a few sentence explanations a day. Pro lifts those limits and adds reading aids without a cap, Anki cards with picture and sound, transcript export, Anki and CSV word export, a bilingual copy of a PDF and article copies. Pro is a pass for a set time or one payment for Pro forever. Full refund within two weeks, no questions asked. Plans and refund terms: https://twinread.exotools.dev/pricing 
PRIVACY
Sent to our server: the licence key, the product name, a random id for this browser and the other fields in the privacy policy, when you activate Pro, about once a day after, and when you remove or replace a key; a diagnostics report, when you press Send. Each language pair's model downloads from Mozilla on first use, and only the name of the pair is sent. Text goes to a provider only for a language pair you route to your own DeepL or OpenAI-compatible key. Saved words go to Anki on your computer when you press Send to Anki. Firefox asks your permission before the key is sent. Privacy policy: https://twinread.exotools.dev/privacy 
PERMISSIONS
• activeTab: the page you are on, when you press the toolbar button or a shortcut
• scripting: adds the translation to the page you pick
• storage: settings, glossary, saved words, language models, licence key, kept in your browser
• unlimitedStorage: room for the language models and a long list of saved words
• alarms: removes a deleted word's card media once its Undo has passed
• firefox.settings.services.mozilla.com and firefox-settings-attachments.cdn.mozilla.net : Mozilla's model servers, where the language models come from
• optional access to any site you choose: asked one site at a time, when you switch on Always translate for it, or the player frame you turn subtitles on in
• optional access to www.youtube.com : asked when you switch on the player button on YouTube pages
• optional access to www.netflix.com , www.primevideo.com , www.amazon.com/gp/video and www.disneyplus.com : asked one site at a time, when you switch on dual subtitles there
• optional access to your translation provider's host: asked when you save an own-key setting
• optional access to 127.0.0.1: asked when you press Send to Anki, to reach AnkiConnect on your computer
Not affiliated with YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ or any other site.
Guides and updates: https://twinread.exotools.dev 
Roadmap: https://twinread.exotools.dev/roadmap 
Twinread is an independent tool and is not affiliated with Mozilla or Google.
